name: Award Travel
tagline: Book the trip on points, for the deepest real value.
rationale: Points are worth a fortune and almost nobody redeems them well. This bundle does: it optimises your cards and miles, plans the trip around your home airport and status, compares the routes that are actually cheap, and books the flights, rail, hotels and event tickets, through official channels and only when you say go.
